desc: Ideate the solution using Binary Search on the Answer.
Implement the `maxScore` method with binary search.
Define the `check(x)` helper logic inside the method to calculate the minimum moves required to achieve a minimum score of `x`.
Ensure the solution is efficient (O(n log(max_score))).
Run the solution against the provided examples to verify correctness.
Check edge cases: `m` is very large, `points` has 1 element, `points` has all same values.
